title: 254 Spartina Circle Vacation Rental
meta_description: 254 Spartina Circle is a 6.00 bedroom, 5.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:- WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pool Passes Included in Rental (Maximum Allotted Wristband Qty is 14)- 6 Adult Bikes Included in Rental- Parking for 3 Vehicles (Garage Not Available)- Pet Friendly (Additional Fee Applies)- Gas Grill- Exterior Shower- Located Directly in Front of WaterColor's Camp District- 6 Minute Bike Ride to the WaterColor Beach Club and Beach Access - 5 Minute Bike Ride to Seaside DETAILS:Welcome to 254 Spartina Circle, nestled in the charming Camp District of Watercolor. This spacious, pet-friendly home is a delightful retreat for families and friends, offering stunning views of Camp WaterColor Pool, Playground, and Wood Fern Park. As you step onto the front porch, cozy lounge chairs invite you to unwind while the children play just across the street. Inside, the heart of the home comes alive. The living room boasts a large white linen sectional, perfect for sharing laughter and stories. The chef's kitchen, equipped with stainless steel appliances and seating for eight, with an open layout. The main-floor master suite is a sanctuary of comfort, featuring a king bed, walk-in shower, jetted tub, and double vanities—a perfect end to a busy day. Venture upstairs, and you'll discover a living area adorned with family handprints, a cozy sleeper sofa, and a TV for movie nights. The second floor offers a second master suite, a playful kids' room with a twin-over-full bunk, and two queen bedrooms—each with its own bathroom, ensuring everyone has their space. For added privacy, the charming carriage house awaits, complete with a queen bed, bathroom, kitchen, and living area—an ideal spot for a quiet retreat or game night. At 254 Spartina Circle, every corner holds the promise of cherished memories and the joy of togetherness, making it the perfect setting for an unforgettable vacation with loved ones. FIRST FLOOR:- Laundry Room- Master Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Soaking Tub and Walk In Shower- Half Bathroom SECOND FLOOR:- Living Area: Queen Sleeper Sofa (2)- Master Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk In Shower- Bunk Room: 1 Set of Twin over Full Bunk Beds (3)- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk In Shower CARRIAGE HOUSE:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk In Shower. PLEASE NOTE: All golf cart rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 60 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.
